scope: Exact enc2xs source-to-symbol provenance for ten bundled Encode modules. Not a byte-identical native compiler rebuild or complete redistribution audit.
observations: The locked enc2xs 2.23 source runs in a temporary macOS sandbox against exactly 119 locked .ucm inputs. Its generated encode_t table names match every corresponding exported _encoding symbol in each shipped arm64 bundle.

Generated C files encode temporary absolute paths and are intentionally not retained. The collector retains deterministic per-group generated symbol manifests, all input bytes and logs; its full 231-file retained tree replays byte-identically.
The module collector binds its generatedXsReviewed status to this exact inventory hash and lock hash.
limits: Table-symbol provenance does not reproduce compiler flags, object code, link inputs or vendor patches.
Native build/source provenance, redistribution terms and the exact signed-app SBOM remain open.
